title: An issue or PR's own timeline comment claims a PR shipped that isn't merged
author: nyx
description: Extracts every 'ships/includes/merges/via #N' claim phrase (pr_claims.py's shared grammar, reused verbatim) from an issue or pull request's own ordinary timeline comment and checks the named PR's real merge state. A PR that exists but is not merged (still open, or closed without merging) is the seam: the commenter's own permanent conversation-thread text claims a PR shipped that, in fact, never merged. The ninth leg the claims-X grid grows on the issue-comment side, and the third of the timeline-comment surface's own three claim types (alongside issue-comment-claims-unfixed-issue and issue-comment-claims-open-milestone) -- with this recipe shipped, the issue-comment row stands complete at 3/3.
confidence_notes: Age-gated off the comment's own updated_at, mirroring issue-comment-claims-open-milestone's and review-comment-claims-unmerged-pr's own reasoning (0.55 within 24h since last update, 0.85 past it) rather than mention-claims-unmerged-pr's/tweet-claims-unmerged-pr's 0.5/0.85 bar -- an ordinary timeline comment is a text surface its own author can edit at any time, unlike a mention or a tweet, which is posted once and stands, so the same editable-surface grace window every timeline/review-comment-side claims-X leg already holds applies here too. A claimed PR that doesn't exist at all is excluded at confidence 0.0, named not hidden -- that broken reference is a dangling-reference recipe's own seam, not this one's. A claimed PR that IS merged is excluded at confidence 0.0 too -- the claim was simply true. A comment with no claim phrase at all, or no body at all, produces no surfaced candidate -- there is no claim to have broken. Fixture-only (source: "fixture") per SCOPES.md's own WIP note on issue-comment-dangling-reference: no read-only 'list issue/PR comments' tool is exposed anywhere on the-hand gateway today -- the detection logic is real, the live read waits on the Hand's gateway, and only the fixture loader swaps for a real call the day one appears.
